  E1 (lattice point 1): polarity=6, pulse=4
  E2 (lattice point 2): polarity=5, pulse=4

  [R0] Edict α: whenever polarity of E1 is odd, pulse of E0 collapses to 0.
  [R1] Edict β: whenever polarity of E1 is even, pulse of E1 collapses to 0.
  [R2] Edict γ: whenever polarity of E1 matches polarity of E2, pulse of E2 collapses to 0.

  [H0] (complete form not recovered — trigger, effect, and affected lattice points are all unknown)
